title: Ancient precision buildings in Peru, Lebanon and Egypt built by another civilization

tellings.quote: the buildings in Peru or in Lebanon, in Egypt, the pyramids, they built it with such precision.

plain: The ancient buildings of Peru, Lebanon and Egypt, the pyramids among them, were built "with such precision" that they must be the work of another civilization, according to a man named Kiran Ilum Xenov. Xenov, whom the episode presents as the president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, offers this to Jesse Michels as his own view, without naming a source.
